software.title: TTTuniverse / Tom Yum Week
software.description: Ongoing web development work for TTTuniverse. The Tom Yum Week project uses Astro and Cloudflare Workers for its campaign website.
bullets: Astro application with a Cloudflare deployment adapter.
Work spans campaign and event-related web applications.

software.title: mayclinic
software.description: Ongoing development of a clinic web application using Next.js, next-intl and MySQL. The project includes Thai and English interfaces and document storage integration.
bullets: Next.js application with next-intl language routing.
MySQL data access and AWS S3 integration are present in the project.

software.title: AXEAN Festival / Fungjai
software.description: Festival web development for AXEAN, covering artist, delegate and organisation profiles. The application combines a Nuxt/Vue interface with a Go backend.
bullets: Nuxt 3, Vue, Vuetify and Pinia on the frontend.
Go API using Gin, GORM and PostgreSQL.

software.title: AUHIP
software.tagline: Desktop AI assistant and Second Brain foundation
software.description: A Python desktop assistant with a PyQt6 interface, speech input, local Ollama routing and optional Gemini integration. Current local development also explores source-linked memory and workspace tools.
bullets: Voice and optional camera/gesture interfaces coordinated through an async event system.
Configurable speech and model engines support local workflows and optional cloud services.

software.title: OpenMeitu
software.description: A local photo editor with deterministic adjustments, style previews, before/after comparison, undo/redo, recipe saving and image export. Reference-based portrait refinement is still being developed.
bullets: JPEG and PNG workflows preserve the original while edits are adjusted.
Manual portrait regions support conservative local edits; automatic face segmentation is not implemented.

specs.value: Local development; no public release or adopted open-source license yet
Reference refinement is ongoing; exact Meitu matching is not claimed

software.title: KinesisOS
software.description: A Python prototype for hand tracking, cursor input and a desktop overlay. The local implementation uses MediaPipe, PyQt6, an adaptive One Euro filter and Windows input calls.
bullets: Hand tracking and adaptive filtering feed the gesture and cursor-input pipeline.
A PyQt6 overlay presents the desktop interface.

software.title: OpenFeder
software.tagline: PDF tools with an MCP gateway
software.description: A PDF-processing prototype combining a Python engine and a TypeScript Model Context Protocol gateway. Modules cover document inspection, annotation, form filling and vector-stroke writing.
bullets: Python engine uses PyMuPDF, FastAPI, Pillow and ReportLab.
TypeScript gateway exposes document tools through the MCP SDK.

software.title: Singing practice engine
software.tagline: Melody and pitch practice in the browser
software.description: A browser prototype for importing a song excerpt, estimating its melody and comparing microphone pitch with editable note targets. It includes a piano-roll view and sharp/flat feedback in cents.
bullets: Local song import, melody estimates and live pitch comparison.
Voice takes can be trimmed, split, pitch-shifted and exported as WAV.

specs.value: Private prototype; generated-example checks completed, real-song and human-voice validation pending
Note and pitch comparison; whole-song key detection is not implemented

software.title: Kindee
software.description: An independent, nutrition-first health technology project focused on making health information easier to understand. Current work centres on evidence-backed content, product research and early web demos.
bullets: Nutrition is the initial focus within a broader whole-body health vision.
Food scanning, wearable integrations and personalised guidance remain ideas to validate, rather than shipped capabilities.

specs.value: Independent from Marsh Me and marchtanu

software.title: StageLink
software.description: Earlier work on performer and venue software, with separate marketplace and venue applications. StageLink is currently inactive as a startup; its architecture remains part of my engineering history.
bullets: The venue application uses Next.js, React and PostgreSQL.
Separate marketplace and venue applications explore different parts of live entertainment work.

software.title: Blackbox
software.description: Audio recognition and review software combining a Next.js dashboard, PostgreSQL storage and a Python capture agent. Recognition adapters and evidence-handling modules support audio analysis and review.
bullets: Source includes recognition orchestration, evidence handling and audio review tools.
A Raspberry Pi capture architecture is documented as a hardware prototype.

specs.value: Development project with a documented hardware prototype; venue deployment and recognition performance need separate validation

software.title: betterLiving

bullets: TypeScript and Fastify support the backend application.
